description: This file defines a custom Android UI component named 'TvChannelCard' that displays information about a TV channel including image, title, live badge, rent badge, and program info. It manages its own layout and view binding, and is optimized for Android TV navigation.

classes.name: TvChannelCard
classes.description: A custom view representing a TV channel card with program info, live badge, and play button, tailored for Android TV navigation and design specifications.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a TvChannel data object to the view, updating displayed information and badges.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on device density.
